caption: The drawing shows a large cylindrical stoneware crock with a wide open mouth and two small, rounded handles on opposite sides. The crock is a light tan color with subtle brownish shading and texture indicating a ceramic surface. The interior of the crock is dark brown. Above the design, there is blue text reading “H & L P NORTON BENNINGTON VT” and below the text is the number “5” also in blue. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details visible.
